blockers.title: /eval/health endpoint missing from backend
blockers.detail: backend/app/main.py contains no /eval/health route. The Playwright globalSetup (Spec A §2 and §6.4) calls this endpoint before the first test. Without it, the harness cannot verify eval mocks are active and must refuse to run. The endpoint must be registered only when EVAL_MOCKS=1.
blockers.fix: Add GET /eval/health to backend/app/main.py per Spec A §6.4. Return {eval_mocks, fred_mocked, gemini_mocked, plaid_mocked}.

blockers.title: seed_runner.py not implemented
blockers.detail: backend/tests/evals/shared/seed_runner.py does not exist. Without it, the fixture cannot be seeded, and all happy-path tests will encounter an empty DB.
blockers.fix: Implement seed_runner.py as a CLI that accepts --fixture <name> and calls Seed().apply(db) with the named fixture. See Spec A §2 and §5 for the fixture definitions.

blockers.title: All 9 Playwright spec files under frontend/e2e/portfolio/ are missing

The entire Spec A test suite is unimplemented.
blockers.fix: Author all 11 spec files per Spec A §2 and §3.

blockers.title: Backend not started; no EVAL_MOCKS server running
blockers.detail: curl to http://localhost:8000/eval/health returned 404 (server present but endpoint missing). Even if the endpoint were added, the backend was not started with EVAL_MOCKS=1 — meaning Gemini, Plaid, and FRED would be called for real during any live test run.
blockers.fix: Start backend with: cd backend && EVAL_MOCKS=1 uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

blockers.fix: Start frontend with: cd frontend && npm run dev
